scope: Exact current 302-path console-decoration payload; evidence inventory, not a grant or public-release clearance.

duane_huseby.note: The GitHub commit page associates the raw Duane huseby author name with the Duimon account, corroborated by PR57 from Duimon/Duimon. Raw names remain preserved. This is a public contribution-account association, not proof of sole authorship, legal identity, ownership, or redistribution permission.

scope_notes: The resource-bundle lock is a materialized-tree SHA-256, not the upstream Git pin.
302 stage paths retain 269 regular files and 33 symlinks. Direct winning-layer path/OID, overwrite chains and virtual-final-tree symlink terminal byte sources are separately recorded.
Git author/committer identities prove recorded account metadata and contributions, not original artwork ownership or a redistribution grant.
Mikael42 commit credits are scoped to changed groups; a message saying mostly is not an exact-file attribution.
git log --follow --find-renames=50% is heuristic; identical .info files and copied artwork can lead to inferred rename/copy ancestry.
Oldest followed change is an observed local-history boundary, not proof that the artwork originated there.
No network fetch, asset modification, binary rewrite, license adoption, or runtime change occurred.
All used histories stop at the pinned revision. The cached repository is non-shallow and contains additional branches/PR refs.
Terminal content is resolved after all three layer copies; resolving a symlink in its original upstream layer alone is wrong for the two amiga alias paths.

Exact-path contribution-name summaries stop after the first heuristic Copy event; older copied/renamed ancestry remains separately available and is not automatically attributed to the final image's original creator.
git log --all contains no commit-message match for license/licence/permission/copyright/cc-by/Creative Commons; that negative result is not a global rights search or a license conclusion.

Exclusive association categories are evidence-routing labels, not verified original artwork authors, sole ownership, licensing status, or permission. Duane-name contributions on the Duimon PR line retain their raw author name; public GitHub commit-account and PR association evidence is recorded separately.
OTHER_EXPLICIT_SOURCE_CREDIT excludes older heuristic Copy ancestors from its positive category; historical credit statements remain available for provenance follow-up.

matrix_legends.D: Recorded Duimon name or publicly corroborated Duane/PR contribution, not sole creator.
matrix_legends.M: Mikael42 account or explicit system-group credit, not sole creator.
matrix_legends.O: Fery65 or Lorenzolamas explicit source credit before copy boundary.
matrix_legends.UNKNOWN_CREATIVE_SOURCE: No positive creative source credit; maintainer Git metadata still recorded.
matrix_legends.T1: Stored upstream image variant and runtime transformation review.
matrix_legends.W0: Source bytes preserved; original/visible watermark completeness unknown.
matrix_legends.W1: W0 plus an observed unversioned Duimon ND hint.

embedded_and_visible_notices.metadata_method: Runtime audit read all 150 staged PNG paths with Pillow without saving images; Photoshop XMP text layers contain nonstandard attribution text in six files.
embedded_and_visible_notices.notice_version: Unversioned family notice; no 4.0 version in this embedded text.
embedded_and_visible_notices.visible_result: Current PS2 standalone-night and SNES no-curve-night variants visibly carry a CC-BY-NC-ND / Duimon URL line; spot checks are not a complete raster watermark audit.
embedded_and_visible_notices.meaning: Positive file-specific license-family and attribution evidence must be retained, not reported as no license text anywhere. It does not by itself establish a versioned complete grant for all layers, derivative contributions or third-party rights. Missing standard metadata in other files is not proof of no license.

license_conditions_and_limits.nd: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 allows noncommercial sharing of licensed material and private creation/reproduction of adaptations, but not sharing adaptations. Section 2(a)(4) permits necessary technical media/format changes without thereby creating Adapted Material. Do not equate all scaling with a prohibited derivative, or assume all clipping/compositing is permitted.
license_conditions_and_limits.sa: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 allows noncommercial adaptations/sharing subject to attribution and ShareAlike on adapted material. A later ND declaration does not automatically revoke already effective SA rights for the same licensed version.
license_conditions_and_limits.attribution: Retain supplied creator identifiers, copyright and license/warranty notices and source links; indicate modifications and include the applicable license text/link. No implied endorsement. Exact creator and version must be identified first.
license_conditions_and_limits.watermarks: Preserve supplied visible credit/copyright/license marks. The public dispute specifically raises removed marks; no watermark removal or restoration was performed. Two staged Commodore PNGs were viewed read-only, but tiny marks were not transcribed or presumed legally sufficient. No blanket mandatory-display or violation finding was made for every image.
license_conditions_and_limits.third_party_rights: A grant covers only rights the licensor can grant. Trademark/logo rights and any embedded third-party materials need separate scope review; being a no-charge or private project alone is not clearance.
license_conditions_and_limits.revision_clauses: Both historical READMEs have or had separate revision wording. Record it, but do not silently treat it as overriding CC 4.0's irrevocable grant or assign a replacement license.

runtime_evidence.scope: Read-only technical audit of the existing 302 consoles-decoration paths; no builds, installations or E2E executions

recipe.semantics: Later same-path entries replace earlier entries; paths without later replacements remain. Relative symlinks resolve inside the final merged consoles tree, not necessarily inside their original source layer.

git_hash_object_vs_cached_git_blob_oid.explanation: git hash-object follows a filesystem symlink and hashes target content; the TSV includes Git symlink-blob OIDs. This is not evidence of asset mutation or line-ending normalization.

resolved_original_layer_cache_vs_stage_c.explanation: The unglazed amiga symlinks remain amiga500.info/png, but their targets are overwritten by the final default_standalone_night layer. Resolve links after merging layers.

limitations: The batocera-bezel audit cache is an extracted tree without its own .git directory; git -C there inherits the Embercade repository and cannot prove an upstream HEAD.
These comparisons establish current stage/reference/installed content preservation. Full upstream pin/blob reconstruction is a separate evidence matrix.
No second-host files were checked in this subtask.

transport_and_static_protection.fact: Development decorations are a directory symlink to the existing reference bundle; no image processing.
Pinned tree digest includes file bytes and symlink text. copytree(symlinks=True) copies the existing resource bundle without image transforms.
Decorations tree digest is 3dd818e528e8889f414de83deafcbebd205a92a028c1c46be424c489b4f43a52; integrity pin, not a license grant.
Installation preserves symlinks, checks regular-file size/SHA256 and symlink targets, and verifies the copied payload manifest.
Static Batocera resources and installed prefix are read-only sandbox mounts; the decoration resource environment points into that installation.
Resolves installed/development decoration roots and optional root override. system_bezel is only a fallback helper, not the complete runtime precedence selector.

runtime_selection.condition: First existing PNG wins. Alternate-system candidates are skipped when alternate is 0. Info/layout/zip paths are associated with the selected PNG.

steps.fact: Overlay initially disabled; none/empty returns without an overlay; PNG required, .info optional and read as JSON.
Sets input_overlay_enable, scale=1, quoted generated overlay.cfg path, and .info/default opacity.
bezel_stretch is configurable and is forced when target width or height is smaller than source dimensions.
Adaptation creates separate PNGs below RETROARCH_OVERLAY_CONFIG.parent/overlays; non-stretch uses uniform min scale and centering for image and viewport.
RGBA padImage uses ImageOps.fit for stretch (may crop) or ImageOps.pad for non-stretch. Re-encodes generated PNG, not the source asset.
Non-RGBA alphaPaste reconstructs a generated RGBA image; if source aspect is wider than target by >0.01 it first center-crops source sides, then fit/pad and output save.
Optional tattoo, QR-code or gun-border branches composite additional generated images. QR/tattoo may cover portions of artwork. These branches were inspected, not executed.
overlay.cfg references selected original or separately generated PNG; overlays=1, full_screen=true, descs=0. No .lay interpretation here.

libretro_transformations.source_asset_mutation: No source PNG/.info write in the inspected normal overlay path; static production resources are also read-only mounts.
libretro_transformations.non_normal_path_caveat: Optional tattoo/QR/gun branches retain sandbox /tmp outputs, and shader-bezel mode has an appliance-style shader_bezels symlink branch. Do not generalize normal adapted-PNG output paths to every optional branch.

steps.fact: For desktop PCSX2/Xemu, upstream appliance prepare_bezel image generation is skipped, while bezel_files remains authoritative.
Reads original PNG IHDR and .info JSON; checks resource containment, matching dimensions, aperture and opacity; does not generate an image.
Loads original PNG into GdkPixbuf; native layer-shell for Hyprland, transparent external-overlay window for Gamescope.
safe_margins takes the minimum of declared aperture and game-protection margins minus one pixel. No emulator/game resize.
Cairo first clips to left/right sidebars, uniformly scales/centers the original full PNG, and paints with .info opacity. Cropping is visual/in-memory; no cropped PNG is saved.
Gamescope external overlay is sized using physical DRM output, not logical Xwayland resolution. Existing external overlay occupancy fails open rather than displacing it.
Visibility requires focused owned fullscreen emulator on exact monitor; lost focus/workspace or IPC failure hides/stops overlay.
Optional helper is launch-scoped, none/dry-run creates none, failures never block emulator; EOF/wait/targeted helper termination handles cleanup.

standalone_transformations.source_asset_mutation: Renderer performs no PNG/info writes; no persistent derived image is produced.

watermark_visibility_risks: Preserving file bytes does not prove preserving every watermark in the rendered viewport.
Libretro stretch/fit and palette-alpha side cropping can remove edges on differing aspect ratios; uniform non-stretch RGBA padding preserves the image extent but rescales text.
Standalone side-only Cairo clipping hides all artwork outside the safe side margins, including any attribution there; conservatively protected auto/wide ratios can reduce these margins to zero.
Opacity, display resolution, interpolation, and optional QR/tattoo composition can reduce visible/readable attribution.
No per-file attribution bounding-box analysis or visual E2E was performed here; no legal compliance conclusion is made.

existing_tests_inspected_not_run.coverage: Synthetic PNG/info configgen overlay, adapted output path, scale/viewport/opacity, no /userdata, source hashes unchanged.
Geometry/game protection, monitor visibility, Gamescope 4K physical surface, no-write validation, None/dry-run, failures, helper lifecycle and user/game precedence.

visual_variant_spot_checks.git_pin_check: Every listed extracted PNG git hash-object equals the blob OID returned by git ls-tree at bezel_recipe_pin in .work/license-audit/git-history/batocera-bezel.git.
findings: PS2 standalone/day, standalone/night, nocurve/day and nocurve/night visibly retain a vertical Duimon / CC-BY-NC-ND attribution line at the upper far-left edge. Night variants darken the artwork and the line; no clear added/removed attribution among these four saved variants was observed.

SNES nocurve/day and nocurve/night visibly retain the corresponding vertical Duimon / CC-BY-NC-ND line at the lower far-left edge. Night is dimmer; no clear added/removed attribution between these two saved variants was observed.

The viewed unglazed PS2/SNES files have no clearly recognizable corresponding vertical side attribution, but their layouts differ substantially. This does not prove removal from an identical predecessor.

Git history for the selected paths includes 8061f0c (added standalone), 85b29ca (added/updated, optimized decorations) and f5f454a (added duimon decorations). Prior historical blobs were not exported or visually checked. Saved day/night variants are not proof of the full chronological derivative chain.
visual_variant_spot_checks.limits: Visual spot checks only, not a complete watermark certification, exact text/OCR inventory, legal permission finding, or rendered-runtime visibility test.

png_text_metadata_audit.scope: All 150 PNG paths in the existing staged consoles tree, symlinks read through their final staged target
png_text_metadata_audit.method: Pillow read-only PNG text extraction, XMP XML element/attribute inspection, plus keyword search in all text values; no images saved
png_text_metadata_audit.limits: Missing standard license metadata is not evidence of no license. Photoshop layer text records attribution wording, not an automatically comprehensive or current grant for each derivative. Visible pixel watermarks can exist without any PNG text metadata. No per-file legal conclusion follows.

runtime_evidence.test_gap: Existing inspected tests do not prove that all embedded attribution/watermarks of every staged asset remain visible/readable under each runtime geometry.
